invalid.because: primitive is misspelt, so a consumer dispatching on the property would never match this node
the primitive property is missing altogether; class alone must not be enough to pass
class is missing the qe-dv-heatmap token, so no div[class~=qe-dv-heatmap] renderer selector matches
tone is outside the closed vocabulary neutral | accent | good | warn | bad
a columns entry has a typo for label, so the header cell it should name has no source property
a rows entry carries a value as a string, which no consumer can put on a numeric ramp
a rows entry has no key, so the row cannot be identified across a rebuild
scale is missing max, leaving the ramp domain open-ended
precision is outside 0-3, so cell text and a consumer-drawn grid could not agree on a format
a second child of a type myst-to-tex has no handler for would be dropped silently from a LaTeX export
a body row marks its label cell as a header, which empties the body of a long table in myst-to-tex
the fallback table is missing, leaving the data reachable only by scraping props
the class string was not normalised: an author token repeats the family token qe-dv, which is exactly the work core's addClassOptions does not do for us

the root carries a top-level label, which myst-cli's embed transform deletes from every node it is not expecting to see one on, so the node would lose it silently the first time the page was embedded elsewhere
a fallback table cell carries an identifier: the same embed transform strips it, and an inner node of this primitive carries a class and nothing else

the retired naLabel is carried: the draft let each block spell a missing value for itself, contract 1.0 spells it one way — null in the properties, an em dash in the fallback — so a node still carrying the option sends a consumer looking for a string that means nothing

a fallback table cell re-describes itself with `contract` and `primitive`; only the root is self-describing, so a consumer that finds one of those knows it has the root without walking upwards, and an inner node carries a class and nothing else
